# Hongda Phytochemistry

> Leading manufacturer and supplier of plant extracts, natural pharmaceutical ingredients, and health supplement powders with FDA, BRC, and organic certifications.

Hongda Phytochemistry is a specialized manufacturer based in Xi'an, China, operating a 20,000 sq meter facility with 10 production lines. The company produces natural plant extracts, carotenoids, vitamins, amino acids, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for global pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and supplement markets, with comprehensive OEM/ODM customization services.

## Key Topics

- Plant extracts
- Pharmaceutical ingredients
- Natural health ingredients
- Carotenoids
- Vitamins and amino acids
- API powders
- OEM/ODM services
- Quality assurance
- cGMP certification
- FSSC 22000
- HALAL and organic certified
- Bulk powder supply
- Herbal supplements
- Bioavailability
- Third-party testing

## Product Lines

- [Products](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/products): Complete product catalog: plant extracts, carotenoids, vitamins, amino acids, and API powders
- [Natural Plant Extract](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/natural-plant-extract): Natural plant extracts including Quercetin, Saw Palmetto, Boswellia, and Green Tea
- [Natural Carotenoids](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/natural-carotenoids): Natural carotenoids: Astaxanthin, Carrot Extract, Haematococcus Pluvialis powders
- [Vitamins And Amino Acids](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/vitamins-and-amino-acids): Vitamins and amino acids: Magnesium Taurate, GABA, Boron, Copper Glycinate powders
- [Other Health Ingredients](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/other-health-ingredients): Health ingredients: Liposomal Ashwagandha, Lutein, Aloe Emodin, Folic Acid powders
- [API Powder](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/api-powder): Active pharmaceutical ingredients: Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, Oxytocin peptide powders

## Services & Manufacturing

- [OEM & ODM Service](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/oem-odm-service): Customized manufacturing: capsules, tablets, instant powders, herbal supplements
- [Our Factory & Warehouse](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/our-factory-warehouse): 20,000 sq meter facility with 10 production lines and comprehensive certifications
- [Quality And R&D](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/quality-and-r-d): Quality control and R&D capabilities including HPLC testing and third-party validation
- [Our Packaging](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/our-packaging): Packaging options: PE bags, fiber barrels, aluminum foil bags for bulk orders

## Certifications & Compliance

- [Our Certifications](https://www.hongdaherbs.com/our-certifications): FDA, BRC, HALAL, KOSHER, organic and food safety credentials including FSSC 22000 and cGMP
